Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator’s first Python solution incorrectly treated XML CATEGORIES (category labels like “Soups and Stews”) as if they were individual food items and compared them directly to spreadsheet food names. This data-structure misinterpretation (category vs. item) broke the logic for finding the one food that lacks an alias and prevented identifying the containing category. The flawed approach persisted (later with namespace tweaks and synonym mappings) and culminated in the wrong conclusion (“no unique food item”), instead of mapping foods to their category and recognizing “Soups and Stews” as the correct answer.
